BiblicalUsage: Shaveh is a plain, and twice it marks where kings met. Chedorlaomer smote the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim, and after the slaughter the king of Sodom went out to meet Abram at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale. A level place between armies becomes the place of meeting.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the plain is where the story turns. Abram comes back from battle, the king of Sodom comes out to meet him, and Melchizedek brings bread and wine, and I hold that God meets His people on level ground after the fight.
